title: prunus virginiana var. pumicea
intro: Prunus virginiana var. pumicea, commonly known as Rocky Mountain chokeberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. This plant is valued for its rich source of antioxidants and potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rocky Mountain chokeberry include its ability to support cardiovascular health, boost immune function, and exhibit anti-cancer properties due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Prunus virginiana var. pumicea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
